**Alexandre Boucaut** (born 10 August 1980) is a [Belgian](./Belgian_people "Belgian people") football referee. He made his debut in the [Belgian Pro League](./Belgian_Pro_League "Belgian Pro League") at 8 February 2009 in a game between [KVC Westerlo](./KVC_Westerlo "KVC Westerlo") and [KSC Lokeren](./KSC_Lokeren "KSC Lokeren").
